name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Either 57 gp goes with Thorne or 47 gp goes with Fenwick.
Kael's gold is higher than both the Paladin and the Conjuration mage.
Cleric, Rogue, and 37 gp go with Fenwick, Kael, and Thorne, in some order.
Druid goes with exactly two of Kael, Evocation, and 57 gp.
Between Thorne and Rogue, one goes with Enchantment and the other with 47 gp.
